title: Papa John’s Draws Fresh Takeover Interest From Qatari-Backed Fund
title_zh: 棒约翰吸引了卡塔尔支持的基金的新收购兴趣
summary: A Qatari-backed investment fund has submitted a bid to take pizza chain  Papa John’s International  private, according to people familiar with the matter.
summary_zh: 据知情人士透露，一家卡塔尔支持的投资基金已提交收购披萨连锁店棒约翰国际 (Papa John’s International) 私有化的报价。

title: Uber’s Zoox deal latest in broad autonomous vehicle push
title_zh: Uber 与 Zoox 达成广泛自动驾驶汽车推广的最新交易
summary: Uber just announced a partnership with Zoox, Amazon’s robotaxi subsidiary, and the stock jumped nearly 3% on the news. Market analyst Jason John summed it up cleanly: “It’s another example of their foray into the AV business. I mean, this is one of many deals.
summary_zh: Uber 刚刚宣布与亚马逊 Robotaxi 子公司 Zoox 建立合作伙伴关系，消息传出后，该股股价上涨近 3%。市场分析师 Jason John 简洁地总结道：“这是他们进军 AV 业务的另一个例子。我的意思是，这是众多交易之一。”

title: Netflix Rival Strikes Deal With Google in Battle for AI Content
title_zh: Netflix 竞争对手与谷歌达成协议，争夺人工智能内容
summary: Media companies are going all-in on artificial intelligence to improve content recommendation tools and cut costs.
summary_zh: 媒体公司正在全力投入人工智能，以改进内容推荐工具并削减成本。

title: Papa John’s Stock Jumps on Reported Takeover Bid
title_zh: 棒约翰股价因收购要约而上涨
summary: Shares of  Papa John’s International  jumped sharply Wednesday after a report that the pizza chain has attracted fresh takeover interest.
summary_zh: 棒约翰国际公司的股价周三大幅上涨，此前有报道称这家披萨连锁店吸引了新的收购兴趣。

title: Salesforce Gears Up For Massive Bond Deal
title_zh: Salesforce 准备进行大规模债券交易
summary: Funding tied to major buyback plan
summary_zh: 与重大回购计划相关的资金
